body:
Your ask (31 Oct): the snake goes in and out of its open terrarium by itself and sleeps inside.
- Out over the low front lip, looks round, back in.
- Sleeps in the half-log hide, eyes closed.
- Needs a free spot about 1.5 in front of the tank.
The coiled sleep pose is too wide for the hide (asked Objects), so it sleeps stretched, head at the opening.

comments.text:
Done: out, look round, back in, sleep in the hide; nothing clips.
Leftovers: 'Back in' jumps at the loop; sleeping eyes small from above.

Updated: the hide is wider now, so the snake sleeps coiled, as you OK'd.
It goes over the lip between the posts; nothing clips.

short: Snake slides out, looks round, sleeps in its hide. OK?
source: Model movements 31 Oct: asks from the Objects chat
title: Snake goes in and out of its terrarium
